## Tabs & Safety

- Confirmed commits on Junos, Cisco IOS XR and Nokia MD-CLI count down to rollback right on the tab (turning red in the last minute) and clear once the commit is confirmed.
- Colour-tagged sessions outline the focused pane in their tag colour, while inactive tabs use a subtle hairline. Every pane reserves steady room for the frame so switching focus or tabs never shifts or reflows terminal text.
- Folders and multi-selections in the session tree now include **Edit Sessions…** and a **Color tag** submenu.
- Tabs running `ssh` show the destination (`ssh alice@web1`) in the tab subtitle and command-completion notifications instead of just `ssh`.
- Workspace icons on the rail can be set to show always, only while a workspace is open, or never (in Settings or the rail's right-click menu).

## Reliability & Performance

- Async UI callbacks now route exceptions to `crash.log`, and concurrent crash-log writes are serialized.
- Terminal rendering recovers cleanly from graphics-device loss on resize, font and DPI changes, stops highlight tints from compounding on idle frames, draws emoji cells and block-cursor clusters cleanly, and tears down native and background-worker state without races.
- Scoped folder backups no longer export or overwrite global settings, workspaces or unused icons; backup imports enforce decompressed size limits and validate archive entries.
- SFTP transfers validate remote filenames, avoid deleting existing files when an in-place upload is cancelled, and run local folder planning and SSHFS mount checks off the UI thread so the window stays responsive.
- Session lock overlays and Command History status, match and diff colors now follow Light, Dark and High Contrast themes.
- Reduced hot-path overhead across command-mark tracking, search, highlight snapshots and prompt scanning, and made remote shell-integration script staging atomic and reusable across connects.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.
